proc quickSort(arr: var seq[int], low, high: int) =
  if low < high:
    let pivot = arr[high]
    var i = low - 1
    for j in low..<high:
      if arr[j] < pivot:
        inc i
        swap(arr[i], arr[j])
    swap(arr[i + 1], arr[high])
    let p = i + 1
    quickSort(arr, low, p - 1)
    quickSort(arr, p + 1, high)

proc selectionSort(arr: var seq[int]) =
  let n = arr.len
  for i in 0..<n:
    var minIdx = i
    for j in i + 1..<n:
      if arr[j] < arr[minIdx]:
        minIdx = j
    swap(arr[i], arr[minIdx])

def merge_sort(arr):
    if len(arr) <= 1:
        return arr
    mid = len(arr) // 2
    left = merge_sort(arr[:mid])
    right = merge_sort(arr[mid:])
    result = []
    i = j = 0
    while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
        if left[i] < right[j]:
            result.append(left[i]); i += 1
        else:
            result.append(right[j]); j += 1
    result.extend(left[i:])
    result.extend(right[j:])
    return result

    if c notin node.children:
      node.children[c] = TrieNode(children: initTable[char, TrieNode]())
    node = node.children[c]
  node.isEnd = true

proc search(t: Trie, word: string): bool =
  var node = t.root
  for c in word:
    if c notin node.children:
      return false
    node = node.children[c]
  return node.isEnd

def max_sum_subarray(arr, k):
    max_sum = sum(arr[:k])
    window_sum = max_sum
    for i in range(k, len(arr)):
        window_sum += arr[i] - arr[i - k]
        max_sum = max(max_sum, window_sum)
    return max_sum

import time

class RateLimiter:
    def __init__(self, max_calls, period):
        self.max_calls = max_calls
        self.period = period
        self.calls = []

    def allow(self):
        now = time.time()
        self.calls = [c for c in self.calls if now - c < self.period]
        if len(self.calls) < self.max_calls:
            self.calls.append(now)
            return True
        return False

limiter = RateLimiter(3, 1)
print(limiter.allow())

import std/tables

type
  LRUCache = object
    capacity: int
    cache: OrderedTable[int, string]

proc get(lru: var LRUCache, key: int): string =
  if not lru.cache.hasKey(key):
    return "-1"
  let value = lru.cache[key]
  lru.cache.del(key)
  lru.cache[key] = value
  return value

proc put(lru: var LRUCache, key: int, value: string) =
  if lru.cache.hasKey(key):
    lru.cache.del(key)
  lru.cache[key] = value
  if lru.cache.len > lru.capacity:
    for k in lru.cache.keys:
      lru.cache.del(k)
      break
